name: Omoide ni Kawaru Kimi ~Memories Off~
original_name: 想い出にかわる君 ～メモリーズオフ～
source:
Shougo is an ordinary if somewhat lazy university student. Instead of studying he prefers to hangout with other regular visitors in a place called the Cubic Cafe. Several years ago his girlfriend Kanata suddenly left him, disappearing without a trace and giving him no message on why she ran off. One day, completely by chance, the two happen to meet each other again in that cafe.

The story takes place in summer, a year after the events of Memories Off 2nd ([url=/v1153]Memories Off 2nd[/url])
translation:
加贺正午是个平凡又有些懒散的大学生。比起专心课业，他更爱泡在一家名叫“Cubic Cafe”的咖啡馆里，和其他熟客一道消磨时光。几年前，女友黑须彼方毫无预兆地不辞而别，既未留下只言片语，也未说明离去的缘由，就此杳无音讯。直到某一天，纯属巧合之下，两人竟在那家咖啡馆里再度重逢。

本作故事发生在《告别回忆2nd》（[url=/v1153]Memories Off 2nd[/url]）剧情落幕一年后的夏天。
